caveat: Single machine, single session. Throughput on this 48 GiB machine is bounded by expert miss loading (13-15 ms of the ~30 ms step) when the GGUF is warm in the page cache and drops to ~21 tok/s when misses come from the SSD; the hit rates and SSD bytes per token are prompt-determined and identical to the M4 Pro 24 GiB record. The dev18 figures in benchmarks/m4pro-24gb-native-dev18.json are from the M4 Pro 24 GiB and are not comparable.
